dispatch.reply: Generated a guide-only AU constitution and the six-step ASIC filing guide.

outputs.content:
COMPANY CONSTITUTION (AUSTRALIA) - GUIDE-ONLY DRAFT
State/Territory: QLD

This is a preparation draft for the owner to review and lodge THEMSELVES with ASIC (via Form 201 or a registered agent). It is not lodged by Lightbulb and is not legal advice.

1. Proposed company name: Sunwash Solar Care Pty Ltd
   Check name availability on ASIC Connect; a proprietary company is typically '<name> Pty Ltd'.
   Alternate names (preference order): Sunwash Solar Care Pty Ltd, Sunwash Roof Care Pty Ltd

2. Registered office (must be in Australia): [REGISTERED OFFICE ADDRESS], QLD

3. Directors (each requires a Director ID from ABRS and a consent to act):
  - [DIRECTOR NAME AND ADDRESS]
   At least one director must ordinarily reside in Australia.

4. Share structure: 100 ordinary shares, fully paid

5. Replaceable rules: this constitution displaces/modifies the replaceable rules in the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) as set out herein.

filing_guide.action: Check name availability on ASIC Connect (or reserve via Form 410).
Ensure each director has a Director ID (director.abrs.gov.au).
Collect director/secretary/member consents and confirm the Australian registered office.
Review the generated Constitution (HITL approval required before you lodge).
Lodge ASIC Form 201 (register a company) directly or via a registered agent and pay the fee.
After the ACN issues, apply for an ABN, TFN, and GST registration if required.
